description: This file defines the ConnectJobFactory class, which is a factory for creating various types of network connection jobs (ConnectJob and its derivatives) based on parameters such as endpoint, proxy, SSL configuration, and other connection settings. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and includes relevant network and utility headers.

classes.name: ConnectJobFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating various network connection jobs based on provided parameters, supporting different connection types such as HTTP proxy, SOCKS, SSL, and transport.

classes.name: ConnectJobFactory::SchemelessEndpoint
classes.description: A struct representing a connection endpoint without a scheme, including SSL usage and host/port information.

methods.name: ConnectJobFactory::CreateConnectJob
methods.description: Creates a ConnectJob based on detailed parameters including endpoint, proxy, SSL configs, and connection options.

methods.name: ConnectJobFactory::CreateConnectJob
methods.description: Creates a ConnectJob based on simplified parameters such as SSL usage and host/port, for non-standard or unknown schemes.
